name: useMicrophoneArray
summary: Microphone inventory: position, orientation, directionality and location of each microphone the platform lists.
plain: Lists the microphones the phone reports (top, bottom, rear), with where each sits and its polar pattern. It only reads the list; it does not steer or focus the microphones.
description: Queries Android AudioManager.getMicrophones() through the native module and returns, for each microphone, its id, description, type, directionality (omnidirectional, bidirectional, cardioid, hypercardioid, supercardioid), location, group and the position and orientation the platform reports, null when it reports none. The hook does not steer or focus the array: MediaRecorder and AudioRecord accept a preferred microphone direction per recorder instance, and this hook owns no recorder, so it exposes no direction or zoom control.

returns.name: microphones
returns.desc: Microphones the platform lists, with position and orientation (null when the platform reports none) and directionality.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether the platform can list microphones (Android 9+).

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if the microphone query failed.

agentNote: Requires Android 9+ (API 28+). The hook only lists microphones; it cannot steer or focus them, so do not present a beam or zoom control.
